publication_note: Core: 26 public scenarios across JMeter, k6, Locust and Gatling (104 tasks). Anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5 uses adaptive thinking at high effort; DeepSeek deepseek-v4-pro uses thinking-high. Both use a 64,000-token output cap and one conditional repair round. Scores are the final answer after the one allowed repair. Costs include all 104 first tries per model and the recorded repair responses (24 for Sonnet, 29 for V4 Pro), estimated from reported token usage at frozen registry prices, not provider invoices. Sonnet was published from Actions run https://github.com/QAInsights/p95-bench/actions/runs/45066297860; V4 Pro from https://github.com/QAInsights/p95-bench/actions/runs/45082823742. Both use merged manifest f07f902e5bf1542afa91818eb962abbdb4873c8999983f17ff7a983a685fc9de.
